==Description==
The '''Tombstone''' was an immobile enemy spawned by the [[Gravekeeper]]. It must be destroyed for the match to end and function essentially like an enemy. The '''Tombstone''' spawned either the [[Normal]], [[Slow]], [[Hidden]] or [[Normal Boss]] when destroyed.

==Appearance==
The '''Tombstone''' is a simple grey slab of stone with the letters "RIP" written in dark grey.

==Strategy==
*Most towers can destroy the '''Tombstone''' relatively quickly.
**Splash damage towers, such as the [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]], can be used to destroy large numbers of these.
*If the '''Tombstone''' is out of the range of your towers, you can relocate your towers to destroy them.
**Alternatively, you can use [[units]] from the [[Military Base]] and [[Crook Boss]] to destroy the '''Tombstone''', as they will eventually reach them, so long that they do not collide with any enemy along the way.

==Trivia==
*The legacy [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] and the [[Gravekeeper]] have a '''Tombstone''' on their back.
